title: docs(adr): ADR-0141 — an app may depend on another installed app: declared in manifest.dependencies, checked once before install, co-owning the namespace it shares
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiSy7TyERBjGhY2v7KGu8Gai)_
Fixes #25403

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Docs-only, Tier H (`docs/adr/**`): the PR stays draft and the maintainer merges it. Records the two maintainer rulings on #25403 — B′ (`6369704387`) and the namespace letter A (`6377678758`) — as a new ADR, and makes the three neighbouring records say the same thing.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**
新增 ADR-0141,把「应用 B 可以声明依赖应用 A」写成契约:声明沿用 `manifest.dependencies`,引用沿用保存门的依赖闭包;唯一新增的关口是**安装前检查**(依赖已装、版本在范围内,否则拒绝并说明缺什么,填上预留的 `dependency_missing`);声明了依赖且命名空间相同的包,在安装门上与被依赖方**共有命名空间**(单向),对象名唯一检查跨发布物同样生效。卸载保护、升级拦截、拓扑/连带安装、被引用方发布标记、市场版本协商逐项写为推迟项;权限不变。另外三处配套:ADR-0028 D4 改为「未声明依赖不得跨应用引用」;ADR-0019 只加一行交叉引用(原文不改);ADR-0130 加附录,D8 的推迟改为「到市场发布时结束」,并标注它关于 #14488 的那一行已过时。

**为什么改**
你在 #25403 批了 B′ 和命名空间 A。HotCRM 想把 revenue 等模块拆成可以单独安装的包(「而每个包可以独立安装」),今天做不到:安装时没有任何地方检查依赖是否已装,单独发布的模块还会因为共用 `crm` 命名空间被安装门拒绝。这份 ADR 定下契约,运行时卡在它合并后再切。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
只改文档,不动代码和 schema。业务上的代价写进了 ADR:卸载或升级被依赖的应用暂时不拦(推迟项),管理员可能把依赖方晾在那里;单独发布的模块和主应用各有版本号,ADR-0130 在同一发布物内消除的版本矩阵会在跨发布物时回来,只靠声明的版本范围约束。回滚:撤销本 PR 的合并即可,没有任何运行时状态。

**席位意见**


**你要做的**
读 ADR 里「Open questions for the maintainer's merge decision」四条(起草时在裁决没说到的地方做的判断:同一发布物内的依赖算已装;只在安装动作时检查、开机重注册不检查;命名空间共有关系不论谁先注册都认;只认直接声明、不认传递)。同意就合并,合并即接受;有异议就在 PR 里点出哪一条。

## What changed

| File | Change |
|:---|:---|
| `docs/adr/0141-inter-app-dependency-declared-checked-before-install.md` | New record, **Proposed**. D1 declaration and reference (no new mechanism) · D2 the pre-install check (what it judges, what it answers, where it runs and where it does not) · D3 the five deferred items, each with its interim state and trigger · D4 permissions unchanged, record-level semantics an open section · D5 dependency-declared namespace co-ownership, one-way, D3 uniqueness across co-owners, ADR-0130 D8's deferral now ending at marketplace publishing · D6 what ADR-0028/0019/0130 now say · D7 the first consumer (a HotCRM module shipping alone, revenue first) · D8 the three dependency shapes and the alignment the runtime card owes |
| `docs/adr/0028-metadata-naming-and-namespace-isolation.md` | D4 rewritten to "no cross-app reference without a declared dependency", with a note quoting the original sentence; the two dependent sentences (D6, leak-point 3) and TL;DR item 4 follow; status line gains an Amended entry. The rest of the record stays Deferred |
| `docs/adr/0019-app-as-consumer-unit.md` | One additive `Related` header line; text unchanged (ADR-0130 D2's recording convention) |
| `docs/adr/0130-release-artifact-as-co-ownership-boundary.md` | One status-header entry and an addendum at the end: D8's deferral end point, and the 2026-09-02 addendum's #14488 line marked stale (that card's state is `not_planned`, ruling `5645322259`). No original text edited |

## Measurements (at `origin/main` `47af3dde42`)

- **Dispatch assumption "nothing at install reads `manifest.dependencies`"** — holds for checking, fails for ordering by one reader: `resolveArtifactPackageEntries` (`packages/core/src/artifact-packages.ts`) feeds every declared id to `resolvePluginOrder` as an optional edge and skips an id outside the artifact silently. No install door checks presence or version; `dependency_missing` occurs only in `app-install.zod.ts`, its test and the generated reference page (zero producers). Recorded in the ADR's Context and Verification notes; no decision moves.
- **Dispatch assumption "the namespace refusal is `NamespaceConflictError` in `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`"** — holds. The gate is lines 5989–6005 (throw at 6003), the co-owner set line 5974, artifact scope only; the line numbers the HotCRM input and the ruling cite (around 5942) have moved.
- **Three dependency shapes, not two**: the manifest record, the marketplace `PackageDependencySchema` array, and a third — `AppManifestSchema.dependencies`, bare ids with no range, in the same file as `dependency_missing`, no reader outside `packages/spec`. `os package publish` snapshots the record shape into `manifest_json`, whose declared schema is the array; the control-plane side lives in `objectstack-ai/cloud` and is not measured.
- **ADR number**: `0136` and `0140` belong to proposals that never landed (#18480; #25618, withdrawn); no open PR carries an ADR. This record is `0141`.
- **In-repo declaring population**: one manifest, `examples/app-multi-package` (orders → core, same artifact) — why D2 counts a co-delivered dependency as present.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (change set vs merge base `47af3dde4`, 4 files, +485 / −12), all 20 run at head `d9b22062`, every one `exit 0`:
`check-adr-links` (+ `--self-test`), `check-adr-symbol-anchors` (+ `--self-test`; 2424 anchors across 143 records resolve), `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` (+ `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-prior-rulings`, `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:watch-hint-literal`.
`dispatch-gates --ran`: 20 derived, 20 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero — every line carried its exit code).
The first run of `check-adr-symbol-anchors` was red on line-number citations in the new record; the second commit replaces them with symbol and file anchors. `check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (prerequisite: `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt), then 0 after building `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint`.
No changeset: `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing (`skip-changeset`).

## Acceptance notes

- hotcrm `docs/architecture/module-split-plan.md`, hotcrm#2270 and hotcrm#2271 are cited as the rulings cite them; that repository is not readable from this session.
- Ruling `6369704387` says "`revenue` first per ADR-0130 §1.3(c)"; §1.3(c) names CPQ as the unsellable module. The ADR records revenue-first as HotCRM's own ordering; nothing moves.
- D5's "recognised whichever registers first" is the drafter's reading of the ruling's "one-way" (declaration and rights one-way, recognition from either side) — needed because a rehydrate that registers the dependent first would otherwise refuse the depended-on app. Listed as merge question 3.
